record.paper_title: Open Problems in K-Stability of Fano Varieties
record.original_question: In the same graded-ideal-sequence setting, does LCP(X, Delta + c a_•) contain a valuation v whose associated graded algebra Gr_v R is finitely generated? More strongly, does it contain a Kollár valuation?

evidence.quote:
Problem 38. In the above notation,
(1) (Weaker version) LCP(X, ∆ +c · a•) contains a valuation v such that the graded algebra
GrvR is finitely generated.
(2) (Stronger version) LCP(X, ∆ + c · a•) contains a Koll´ar valuation.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a normal complex variety and $\Delta$ an effective $\mathbb{Q}$-divisor on $X$ such that $(X,\Delta)$ is a klt pair. Let $\mathfrak{a}_\bullet = \{\mathfrak{a}_m\}_{m\in\mathbb{Z}_{>0}}$ be a graded sequence of nonzero coherent ideal sheaves on $X$ (i.e. $\mathfrak{a}_p\cdot\mathfrak{a}_q\subseteq\mathfrak{a}_{p+q}$ for all $p,q$), and let 
$$c = \mathrm{lct}(X,\Delta;\mathfrak{a}_\bullet) := \lim_{m\to\infty} m\cdot \mathrm{lct}(X,\Delta;\mathfrak{a}_m)$$
be its log canonical threshold. Define the set of log canonical places of the formal triple $(X,\Delta+c\cdot\mathfrak{a}_\bullet)$ as 
$$\mathrm{LCP}(X,\Delta+c\cdot\mathfrak{a}_\bullet) = \{\,v \in \mathrm{Val}_X^* \;:\; A_{X,\Delta}(v) = c\cdot v(\mathfrak{a}_\bullet)\,\},$$
where $A_{X,\Delta}$ is the log discrepancy and $v(\mathfrak{a}_\bullet) = \lim_m v(\mathfrak{a}_m)/m$. For a valuation $v$ on $R = \mathcal{O}_{X,x}$ (or the function field), let $\mathrm{Gr}_v R = \bigoplus_{\lambda} \{f : v(f)\geq\lambda\}/\{f : v(f)>\lambda\}$ be its associated graded algebra. A valuation $v\in\mathrm{LCP}(X,\Delta+c\cdot\mathfrak{a}_\bullet)$ is called a Kollár valuation if there exists a projective birational morphism $\pi:Y\to X$ extracting a single prime divisor $E$ such that $v = \mathrm{ord}_E$ and $(Y,\pi_*^{-1}\Delta + E)$ is plt with $-(K_Y+\pi_*^{-1}\Delta+E)$ ample over $X$.

Prove or disprove:
\begin{enumerate}
\item (Weaker version) $\mathrm{LCP}(X,\Delta+c\cdot\mathfrak{a}_\bullet)$ contains a valuation $v$ such that the associated graded algebra $\mathrm{Gr}_v R$ is finitely generated.
\item (Stronger version) $\mathrm{LCP}(X,\Delta+c\cdot\mathfrak{a}_\bullet)$ contains a Kollár valuation.
\end{enumerate}
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work has established related results: a valuation computing the lct of a graded sequence of ideals can be taken to be quasi-monomial (Jonsson–Mustaţă-type theorems), and finite generation of the associated graded algebra has been proven for quasi-monomial valuations on qdlt Fano-type models (and recently extended via extended Rees algebras in work from 2025). However, no source confirms a complete resolution of the existence of an LCP valuation with finitely generated graded algebra, nor of a Kollár valuation in LCP, in the generality stated. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Finite generation of higher rank quasi-monomial valuations via the extended Rees algebra
status_evidence.snippet: finite generation has been proved for quasi-monomial valuations on models of qdlt Fano type … generalized using different arguments by studying the extended Rees algebra
status_evidence.claim: Finite generation results in this direction are still being developed and extended; full statement remains an active topic.

status_evidence.title: A note on Kollár valuations
status_evidence.snippet: the set of Kollár valuations in the dual complex of a klt singularity with a fixed complement is path connected
status_evidence.claim: Recent work studies structural properties of Kollár valuations in LCP but does not establish their existence in the graded-sequence setting.
